# <span id="aanchor279"></span> Location Tree View

The location Tree View provides a visual structure for all locations that are a root location or are a member of a root location. This is ideal for keeping track of locations that are nested within larger locations.

<div class="procedure">

To access the location Tree View:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Location** \> **Tree View**.
2.  Select a location in the left-hand panel.
3.  The location members as of the date in the Date field will display. If the location membership has changed over time, change this date to see the membership as it was on different dates.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 562;height: 414;" />

Clicking the up/down arrow at the top next to the **Number** heading to sort members in ascending order (up arrow) or descending order (down arrow).

When you have selected a root location, you can drill down to see meter and location members. As you click on members of the location, the members of that member will display in the right-hand panel. By default, the left-hand panel does not show meter members. To display meter numbers in the meter members, click **Show** on the menu bar and select **Meters**.

The Path field displays the path to the top of the selected root location. Click the **Search** button to the right of the **Path** field to access the Path Finder. In the Path Finder, select items (left column) to display their membership in root locations (right column).

To find a specific meter or location, enter information in the search field at the top and click **Filter** to find items that match your criteria.

</div>
